messages:
marta: Working on a short docs patch to tighten SOC2 wording around audit-log retention and tenant data handling. I want: a clear default retention statement, an example showing tenant-scoped events, and a tiny JS SDK migration note. Can folks sanity-check?

ryan: Sure. What's the current retention line?

marta: Right now it reads: "Audit logs are retained for 90 days." I want to change to: "By default, Redwood retains audit logs for 90 days; enterprise customers can request longer retention via contract." Also call out that retention is configurable for Dedicated/Private installs.

legal_sam: +1 on conservative phrasing. Suggest adding: "Retention durations are documented defaults and subject to contract terms. Redwood segregates tenant logs; no cross-tenant access is permitted." Also add a short encryption note: "Logs are encrypted at rest; Private deployments may use customer-managed keys (KMS)."

marta: Good. I also want a small JSON example that demonstrates tenant-scoped event and a redaction hint. Draft:```json
{
  "name": "model.invoke",
  "tenant_id": "acct_42",
  "data": { "prompt": "***REDACTED***" },
  "redacted_fields": ["prompt"],
  "ts": "2026-04-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```
Is that clear enough?

ryan: That looks good. For the JS SDK migration, we renamed the audit method. Old: `client.audit.log()` -> New: `client.audit.emit()` and field names changed. Proposed inline snippet:```js
// previous
await client.audit.log({ event: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'acct_42', payload });
// now
await client.audit.emit({ name: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'acct_42', data: payload });
```
Also mention that casing changed: tenantId -> tenant_id in wire JSON; SDK normalizes to camelCase.

marta: Helpful. I'll add a short migration section: "If you previously used client.audit.log, switch to client.audit.emit; see example."

docs-ci-bot: lint: docs/soc2-audit.md: avoid absolute claims like "we never"; prefer "Redwood does not expose tenant logs to other tenants". Also flagged missing KMS note for Private.

marta: Thanks bot, will incorporate.

ops_eli: One ops note: we shouldn't publish the API path prominently. If you need to include a curl example, put it in an appendix labeled "operator-only" and prefix with a warning about auth and internal endpoints. Example:```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.cluster/v1/audit \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"name":"model.invoke","tenant_id":"acct_42","data":{}}'
```

marta: Perfect. I'll keep the SDK examples primary and add a small appendix for the curl snippet with an "operator-only" note.

legal_sam: One more legal nit: add a sentence that customers responsible for PII in prompts should consider redaction or shorter retention and that Redwood will honor contractual retention requests.

marta: Will add that and open the PR. Draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2491 (WIP). Tagging @legal_sam and @ryan for review.

ryan: I'll review later today. Quick ask: include a one-line example of `redacted_fields: ["prompt"]` in both JSON and SDK examples so implementers can copy-paste.

marta: Done. I'll ping when CI passes. Thanks! :sparkles:
